status: Prospectively fixed local protocol; not externally preregistered. Test conditions reserved from development, with no performance-based tuning.
design: Continuous-time LQR at upright equilibrium, same Q/R for every assumed payload. Control sampled at 200 Hz and torque saturated. Gains fixed within each run; no online payload estimation.
tuning_budget: Zero performance-based parameter searches. Original Q/R and sensing covariance retained. Development runs check implementation only.
test_seed_formula: 5003 + 104729*i, i=0..29. Same seeds across variants; distinct from prior studies.
force_location: Combined true body COM; the true force moment arm changes with true load, never with its estimated load.
primary: Fall by 10 s at control endpoints, absolute true tilt >=45 deg
secondary: Original final-one-second recovery dwell; final-second RMS tilt/position/speed; torque squared integral and saturation fraction. Full-horizon paired metrics only when both compared trials survive.
statistics: Paired transitions by condition/seed; deterministic totals descriptive. Wilson 95% intervals only per noisy fixed condition. IQR for paired continuous differences. No aggregate deployment probability or unpaired significance tests.
numerical_audit: All 1296 ideal test records repeated with two RK4 substeps preserving 200 Hz control; any changed labels repeated with four.
independent_check: Selected ideal test trajectories checked with independently assembled component mass matrix and SciPy DOP853 under held 200 Hz control. Numerical cross-check, not independent multibody/hardware validation.
